title: quercus coccifera subsp. arcuata
intro: Quercus coccifera subsp. arcuata, commonly known as Kermes oak, is a subspecies of evergreen oak tree native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions. The health benefits of Quercus coccifera subsp. arcuata include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions such as astringency, antisepticism, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Quercus coccifera subsp. arcuata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
